nom: IUNIK Beta-Glucan Power Moisture Serum - Deep Hydration 1.69 fl oz

avis.texte: This beta glucan moisturizer is a nice, simple hydrating serum I’ve added to my routine, and it works well as a supportive layer alongside my other skincare. I use two topical medications to help manage rosacea, so I’m always careful about what I layer underneath them, and this has been gentle enough that I haven’t had any issues with irritation or sensitivity. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly without leaving any stickiness or residue, which makes it easy to layer under moisturizer or medication. It feels more like a calming hydration step than anything heavy or occlusive, which is exactly what I want in this part of my routine. Looking at the ingredient list, this is a very minimal, hydration-focused formula. It is built mainly around humectants like glycerin, butylene glycol, sodium PCA, and beta-glucan, all of which help draw water into the skin and support moisture balance. Beta-glucan is a standout here because it is known for being both hydrating and soothing, which fits well for sensitive or reactive skin types like mine. Adenosine adds a mild skin-conditioning effect, and the rest of the formula is essentially there to stabilize texture and delivery rather than act as “active” treatment ingredients. Overall, this feels like a straightforward, no-frills serum that does its job well: keeping the skin hydrated and comfortable without triggering irritation. Price at time of review: $19.59, with 10% off coupon available at checkout

avis.titre: No Fuss Moisture Retention / On My Third Bottle
avis.texte: I am on my third bottle of the Beta-Glucan Power Moisture Serum because I love it that much. While I'm not prone to breakouts, I have sensitive, combination skin where I'm oily in my T Zone and dry everywhere else and also have rosacea. This serum has never agitated my skin and seems to really help with my moisture retention. I use it twice a day have a very minimal skincare routine consisting of toner, this product, and sunscreen in the morning or moisturizer at night. I love how lightweight it goes on and doesn't leave my skin feeling tacky, plus it plays well with other products. It's a small bottle but it lasts about 3 months using it twice per day so I feel like it's pretty cost effective compared to other serums. This is a very no fuss product if you're someone looking to heal or maintain your skin barrier and improve moisture retention!

For reference, I’m in my early 40s with combination skin and perioral dermatitis which causes painful inflammation around my nose and mouth. I’ve been using the matching Iunik Beta-Glucan moisturizer with this for over a year now. I only use this serum during the winter months when my skin feels less oily or anytime it feels drier than usual. I add a drop or two to the moisturizer, mix, then apply. My skin loves it. Non-greasy, not sticky, and no excessive shine throughout the day. I’ve used it alone as well after toning and no sticky feel. Now, I haven’t seen any real anti-aging results, but it has helped soothe my irritated, red skin. Adding Azaleic Acid cream to my routine has made a huge difference as well for my dermatitis. This serum is a part of my daytime routine. I use something stronger that targets wrinkles and uneven skin tone at night.

avis.titre: Hydrating Serum, But the Dropper Falls Short
avis.texte: I really enjoyed this serum! It has a minimal, clean ingredient list and leaves my skin feeling deeply hydrated with a healthy, glowy finish. It layers well with the rest of my skincare and never felt heavy or sticky, making it great for my dry, dehydrated skin. The only reason I won’t be repurchasing is the packaging. I wish it came in a pump instead of a dropper. My skincare routine is usually quick, and because the serum is thick, the dropper doesn’t pick up much product at a time, so I had to go back in multiple times. If they ever switch to a pump, I’d happily give it another try.

avis.titre: Must have if you have rosacea and sensitive reactive skin!!!

It is a drink of water that hydrates and makes my face feel so good. It does not cause redness or any irritation I use this morning and night. I can not use any actives and this is my favorite product. I am 52 years old and everyone does not believe it and I always asked what I use. This may be my favorite skin care product ever. I can not live without this serum. The results are amazing skin is soft, glowy, and plump. Perfect under makeup.

Great product for dry skin! I can definitely see myself purchasing this again. I’ve been using it on my face before bed, and I’ve already noticed an improvement in my skin’s texture and overall appearance. My complexion looks more even, and my skin feels smoother and more hydrated. I’m still figuring out how often my skin responds best to it, as I don’t want to overuse it or risk clogged pores. Everyone’s skin is different, so I’d recommend paying attention to how your skin reacts and adjusting your usage accordingly. Applying it to the areas that need the most hydration has worked well for me so far.

avis.titre: Good for weak skin barrier and dehydrated/very dry skin
avis.texte: My purchase was carefully packed, so no issues there. It also had 2 authentication stickers on it. One seal has a hologram on it. You download a program, then you scan the code on the seal to verify authenticity. This is very hydrating. I could tell a difference the morning after I first applied. It would be better if used with the lotion, probably. It's very thick but absorbs quickly. Do you need this? I would only get this if you have a weakened or distressed skin barrier. If you just need something for moisture, hyaluronic acid will do the job. Unless you have severely dry skin, you may not even need a serum because so many products have hyaluronic acid these days. I purchased this because I have a compromised skin barrier and my skin is very dehydrated this winter.
